description: This file defines an Android activity named NoteDetailActivity that manages the creation, viewing, editing, and deletion of notes within a note-taking app. It interacts with a content provider and database helper to perform CRUD operations on note entries.

classes.name: NoteDetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class responsible for displaying, editing, and deleting a note. It handles user interactions, loads data from a content provider, and updates the database accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout and theme, fetches note ID from intent, and sets up button click listeners.

methods.name: loadNote
methods.description: Queries the content provider to load a note by ID and populates the UI fields with the note's title and content.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Collects data from UI, creates ContentValues, and inserts or updates the note in the database.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog before deleting a note; if confirmed, proceeds to delete.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the current note from the database via content resolver.
